info.title: VeriMedia Agent Tool API
info.description: API contract for autonomous agents to inspect image metadata health, check for E-E-A-T credentials, and verify AI training opt-out states.

post.description: Inspects a public image URL to check if sensitive GPS/camera EXIF details exist, and verify if E-E-A-T tags or AI opt-out indicators are present.

imageUrl.description: The public HTTP URL of the image to be analyzed.

gpsCoordinatesFound.description: True if private GPS coordinate tags are present.

cameraHardwareExposed.description: True if hardware serials or model strings are visible.

hasEeatCredentials.description: True if Google-compatible IPTC/XMP licensing fields are present.

hasAiOptOutInjected.description: True if an explicit opt-out indicator is written in the metadata.

metadataHealthScore.description: Rating out of 100 on metadata security and SEO compliance.
